description:
Add a synonym/alias (tenant-scoped or global demo) — E4 compounding thickens search boost + Fact extract. ≤60/hour/key → 429. Idle $0. No invented premiums.

POST /v1/pbx/dictionary/add {term, alias, domain:otel|santral_firmasi|sigorta|finans|enerji|otomotiv, scope?:pbx|global}. Managed SaaS compounding (E4): tenant-scoped aliases thicken search + fact extract. No invented premiums/prices. Idle $0, no LLM. Legacy msp → santral_firmasi.

alias.description: Synonym / alias to add (e.g. cooling, line package).

domain.description: Domain: otel | santral_firmasi | sigorta | finans | enerji | otomotiv (legacy msp accepted).

kind.description: Fact kind; inferred from seed term when omitted.

scope.description: pbx = scoped to x-temsor-pbx-key; global = demo-wide. Default: pbx if registered key, else global.

term.description: Canonical term (e.g. AC, tariff). Plain Turkish preferred.
